name: mailsite-agent
description: Let non-technical site owners update their static website by email; an agent applies the change, previews it, and publishes on approval.

comments.dependencies: Core (gmail + resend providers) is dependency-free and uses built-in fetch. The three optionalDependencies are ONLY needed for the IMAP provider (ProtonMail-via-Bridge, Fastmail, generic IMAP). npm install pulls them when available; if they're missing the IMAP provider prints an install hint.
